entries.en: And what? Hacked it from here?
entries.ro: Și ce? L-ai hack-uit de aici?

entries.en: No. Those servers were just a proxy. Smoke screen.
entries.ro: Nu. Serverele alea erau doar un proxy, o diversiune.

entries.en: Where's the signal lead? You know?
Nope. Link was hashed. But we'll get there. Just a matter of time.
entries.ro: Nu. Conexiunea e hash-uită. Dar ajungem noi acolo, e doar o chestiune de timp.
